note: Hancock County Conservation Board park on the east shore of Crystal Lake (1045 320th St, mailing Forest City). Sites 1-10 are lakeside, 1-7 along the shore; sites 11-68 are on a bluff overlooking the lake at the north end. The only public boat launch and beach on the lake. --Claude
summary: $20, 50-amp, May 1-Oct 15, 14 nights confirmed. Count 87->68. FCFS-only -> 41 of 68 reservable, with window, 5-day cutoff, 2/3-night minimums. Pin 700 m off. Lakefront lead (sites 1-7).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD, stored lakeview looks too low for sites 1-7; the stored note's 'RV pad rows sit back from the lake behind a road/treeline' describes neither the county's map text nor imagery at the correct place. County: 'Sites 1-10 are lakeside sites ... many offering shoreline camping', 'Sites 1-7 along the shore provide a great opportunity for fishing from your own campsite', Site 1 page: 'located on the Shoreline of Crystal Lake' (72 ft x 15 ft); Site 10 'near the Shoreline'. Esri at 43.2295,-93.7844: a gravel strip about 200 m long runs along the shore, water about 10-25 m from the gravel with scattered shoreline trees and no separate road on the lake side seen; imagery shows no RVs, so I can't tell pads from driving lane, and whether the strip's lane passes on the lake side of the pads needs AWH's rule on the loop road. Beach and ramp are at the south end, beyond sites 1-10. Sites 11-68: county says 'on a bluff that overlooks the Lake', under heavy canopy (lakeview at best from there).

PIN WRONG: stored 43.22480,-93.78780 is about 700 m SW of the park, on a lot packed with RVs at the edge of the town of Crystal Lake, across the lake's south end. Corrected campground centre about 43.2305,-93.7840 (lakeside strip 43.2295,-93.7844, upper loops 43.2312,-93.7835; loops visible on Esri, pads under canopy in the upper loops).
